prompt:
Our wellness platform needs to process a batch of pending fortune consultation requests from a queue file located at data/raw/batch_consultations.json in the workspace. Each record contains a consultation ID, a client datetime, and a consultant name.

For each of the 4 pending requests, perform a proper Xiao Liu Ren (小六壬) divination using the exact datetime provided, then compile all four results into a single file named divination_report.json.

The report must contain the full three-palace sequence (month, day, and hour palace) for each request, including the complete interpretive meaning (meaning field) for the hour palace. The results must be accurate — our QA team will independently recompute each divination to verify correctness.
